error[ZBX-E0556]: the registry refused the manifest
  while  pushing an image
  cause  registry.test refused the manifest for tag 'v1': it answered 400
  host   registry.test
  status 400
  code   MANIFEST_INVALID
  fix    run the same command again; what the registry already holds is not sent twice
  more   zbx explain E0556
